statement: A retrieved review of legal retrieval states that diachronic (temporal) failure is the least well integrated into mainstream RAG practice, that existing solutions are stronger at representation than at retrieval-time enforcement, that corpora are often versioned only at document granularity so whole-document snapshots obscure structural-unit (clause-level) differentials, and that the relevant test is whether a system can return the text in force at a queried date T.

evidence.quote: diachronic blindness is the one least well integrated into mainstream RAG practice
most solutions remain stronger at representation than at retrieval-time enforcement
the corpus may be versioned only at document granularity, producing whole-document snapshots that obscure structural-unit differentials
can the system return the text that was in force at T
